note: 2026-11-26 probe 7d/7e: the FULL optical read chain runs on console and SURVIVES (open(4,2,0)=0 -> allocate_device_dma_region(174)=0xc0000000 -> map_device_dma_region(176) -> storage_read(245) -> poll get_async_status(249)), all forwarded sc0, no patch A. BLOCKER: map(176) returns -17 = LV1_ILLEGAL_PARAMETER_VALUE (size 0x100000 ruled out in 7e). Cause: the DMA target buffer must be PAGE-ALIGNED (0x1000) guest-physical, but the 8KB owned block (base 0x80022440, unaligned) cannot host a page-aligned 2KB+ buffer clear of the integrity-checked command/data patterns that gate snapshot delivery. FIX (probe 7f): dedicated page-aligned DMA buffer -- enlarge the owned allocation (N 0x2000->0x4000, DMA page at (alloc+0x2000)&~0xfff, past the patterns) or a separate page-aligned region. map(176) arg order proven: r3=bus,r4=dev,r5=lpar_addr(page-aligned),r6=dma_region,r7=size,r8=flags 0xe000000000000800.
